target.name: Saturn
target.title: Saturn and its moons
target.text: Saturn and five of its moons, night of 17/18 October 2026 (frames of 18 October UTC)

flat.why: no flat: a 93 arcsec tile on the planet; the sky is each plane's own median, subtracted per frame

hot_pixels.why: the planet moves on the sensor between frames and the mean of 25 frames carries any single hot pixel at 1/25

steps.history: 488 frames at 1/60 s ISO 800 (RAW EXIF) from 05:20:00 to 07:25:00 UTC, each graded by sharpness and light; the moons from 2 s ISO 6400 (RAW EXIF)

numbers.source: JPL Horizons, geocentric astrometric (ICRF), 2026-10-18 05:20 to 2026-10-18 07:26 UTC every 1m

steps.history: JPL Horizons, geocentric astrometric (ICRF), 2026-10-18 05:20 to 2026-10-18 07:26 UTC every 1m

numbers.why_kept: plain stacks: 8 to 25 one plateau (within 3%), 5 sharper by gap contrast (0.145 vs 0.127); restored: 25 beats 5 (gap contrast 0.359 vs 0.313) with 0.0059 vs 0.0135 grain and Titan at 18 vs 8 sigma; checks/k5-vs-k25-rounds-0-8-12-20.png

steps.history: the sharpest 25 frames (light within [0.8, 1.25] of the median); the field turns -0.0264 deg per minute, every frame turned back to 322.583 min UTC

each colour plane laid on a grid 3 x finer than the sensor at its own place in the 2 x 2 cell, turned back and shifted in one Lanczos resampling, mean of 25; red and blue slid onto green by least squares ({'red': [0.313, 0.363], 'blue': [-0.519, -0.543]} sensor px); residual 0.115 fine px rms

record.name: Gaia DR3
record.epoch: positions at 2016.0 (ICRS); move them with the proper motions to the night

numbers.note: colours were not slid in this tile: the red and blue offsets are the air's prism at Titan, to compare with step 5's on the planet

numbers.method: Richardson-Lucy on R+G+B, each colour scaled by the same ratio

numbers.planet_from: restored stack, 3x3 box mean, one linear resampling

steps.how: brightness changed, each pixel's colour ratios kept

steps.brightness: bilateral filter, sigma 4.0 px, 7 L units
steps.where: full below L 10, none above L 35 (brightness judged on a blurred copy)

steps.left_alone: below L 14 (fading in to L 30) and above L 93
steps.sky_without_colour: colour fades to grey below L 10 (full colour from L 22): the dark sky's colour is noise

wcs_check.what: Saturn-centred WCS, not a plate solve: scale and turn from five moons against JPL Horizons (step 6), CRVAL Saturn at DATE-AVG; checked on the ring's long axis

made_from: this recipe had no time of its own: the time of the commit that first delivered it
software_note: the versions in this environment when the recipe was brought to the schema; the packages were installed before the night and not changed since
telescope: Celestron 8SE, 203 mm, 2084 mm by plate solve
